Our story

Built on values. Led by Estevam Castro.

A Cape Cod family business since 2013 — built day by day with hard work, faith and dedication.

Since 2013

Born from a dream. Built day by day.

Castro Carpentry Inc. started in 2013 as a small family business. Over more than twelve years, the team has grown — but the way we work hasn't changed.

Estevam Castro, our founder, is a husband, a father of two, and someone who genuinely loves the work. To him, carpentry is about discipline, purpose and leaving something that lasts.

Today Castro is a solid, reliable and respected name across Cape Cod — known for transparency, reliability and precision. No shortcuts, no hidden costs, and work delivered on schedule.

“We don't just build with wood. We build with values.”

— Estevam Castro, founder
